text: Ironvale Athletic’s tactical discipline in maintaining a low block and deep defensive line successfully absorbed Redmond Rovers’ high press and defensive line, allowing them to regain possession deeper and launch effective counter-attacks. Over an 8-minute span around the 59th minute, they increased final third entries to 4 and created 3 shots totaling an xG of 0.79, culminating in Jonah Lindqvist’s goal at 61’ [#1133] [#1157]. Despite lower possession (43.8%) and a pass accuracy of 84.6%, their direct, vertical passing exploited spaces behind the high defensive line effectively. The key coaching point is to instruct your team to remain compact and patient under high pressing teams, focusing on quick vertical transitions to punish high defensive lines.
